title: AI Ordering Your Groceries? Check THIS Before You Click #shorts
description:
Google's Gemini in Chrome auto browse can handle multi-step web tasks, including shopping or filling forms, on eligible paid plans. Before letting an AI browser act: check the SITES it chose, the PERSONAL INFO it could share, and any APPROVAL before a sensitive task.

Would you trust AI with a FORM or a CART? Comment your answer. Full India auto browse explanation on FlowMinute Lab.

Google official help: https://support.google.com/gemini/answer/16821166?co=GENIE.Platform%3DAndroid&hl=en

Illustrative fictional shopping task, not a purchase or live screen recording. #AI #Gemini #Chrome #OnlineSafety #shorts
